mechanism.claim: At a fixed eight-hour boundary in an unusually volatile completed BTC block, a final two-hour price move confirmed by same-direction net aggressive quote flow identifies sponsored price discovery rather than passive drift. Follow the confirmed direction for six elapsed hours.
mechanism.side: common strict nonzero sign of final-two-hour return and final-two-hour normalized taker imbalance
mechanism.why_distinct: HVAFC requires direct Binance aggressive-flow confirmation in the final two hours. HVSAR required an opposing 6h/2h price path and late volume concentration; daily flow candidates used one daily clock and different cross-book or contrarian geometry. No prior control is promoted.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed eight-hour realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: three fixed UTC flow-confirmation clocks with final-two-hour microstructure are absent from Gross9

features.block_valid: 480 exact distinct minute rows in [decision-8h,decision), finite positive coherent OHLC, finite nonnegative quote_asset_volume and taker_buy_quote, taker_buy_quote<=quote_asset_volume, positive final-two-hour quote volume; no imputation
features.flow_gate: abs(late_taker_imbalance)>=0.10 and strict sign agrees with late_return
features.realized_variation: sum squared 1m close-to-close log returns within completed 8h block
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank among at most 270 valid fixed eight-hour blocks, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding_oi_premium_implied_vol: not signal inputs; exact funding only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source-support and Gross9 novelty pass

stopping_rule: Terminal first-failure sequence: source support, Gross9 novelty, strict economics; no threshold, side, hold, clock, flow, or subset repair.
